content: Meilisearch filter conventions (official docs): expression syntax attribute OP value with =,!=,>,>=,<,<=,TO (inclusive range),IN,NOT IN,EXISTS,IS NULL,IS EMPTY,CONTAINS,STARTS WITH; precedence NOT>AND>OR, parentheses required; array form outer AND inner OR max depth 2; attributes must be declared filterableAttributes; = case-insensitive, no null/empty match, array = matches any element. Filtering happens BEFORE relevancy ranking within the filtered set. facetDistribution is query+filter aware; facetStats numeric min/max. No built-in disjunctive faceting (client-side multi-search pattern).
